source_metadata.title: Alveolar osteitis associated with methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus epidermidis

stable_identifier_external_verification.basis: PubMed metadata; not printed in the supplied PDF

notes: Figure-derived observations were kept separate from narrative findings because the visual locators are independently reviewable.

extraction_limitations: The source is a single case report and does not support causal or comparative treatment-effect estimates.
Cefixime and azithromycin dose, route, and frequency are not reported in the supplied source.
The susceptibility section reports categorical resistance for selected agents but does not provide inhibition-zone diameters or MIC values.

The microbiological specimen was collected from the pulpal chamber/root canals before extraction, not from the post-extraction socket at the later alveolar osteitis presentation; organism-to-alveolar-osteitis causality therefore remains uncertain.
No dedicated funding, conflict-of-interest, or data-availability statement was identified in the four-page source.
Paragraph/sentence numbering is not printed in the PDF; anchors therefore use source section, printed page, and short verbatim excerpts.
schema_gaps: The current atom model has no dedicated case-report event kind; temporally ordered clinical events are represented with existing population, intervention, qualitative-result, method, and author-conclusion kinds.

Categorical antimicrobial susceptibility findings do not map naturally to QuantitativeResult without MIC or zone measurements; they are retained as qualitative_result atoms rather than fabricated quantitative values.
